how_to_apply: UR/OBC/EWS candidates pay the application fee of Rs.1770 (including 18% GST) plus transaction charges into the AIIMS Bibinagar bank account given below. SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates pay no application fee. The cut-off date for paying the fee is 3 November 2026.
Fill in the online application form (Google form), available on www.aiimsbibinagar.edu.in. The notice also gives a direct link, "Google form application for SR(NA)".
Submit the Google form by 3 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Late and incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.
Fill in the application form in Annexure-I (personal details in capital letters) and attach a recent passport-size photo.
Bring the filled Annexure-I form, the original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies to the document verification and interview.
The application fee will not be refunded under any circumstances once paid. Candidates working in Govt. or Semi-Govt. PSUs must apply through proper channel.

The Annexure-I form asks for the advertisement number, the department applied for, the post (Senior Resident (Non-Academic), 89 days tenure), full name, father's name, correspondence and permanent addresses with PIN code, email, phone and alternate number, date of birth (with a supporting document), nationality, state, PwBD type and percentage, and category. It also asks for educational qualifications (10th, 12th, MBBS/BDS/M.Sc., MD/MDS/MS/Ph.D., DM/DNB/M.Ch, any other, with the number of extra attempts), work experience, publications in indexed national and international journals, and the minimum time needed to join. The form ends with a signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bibinagar
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bibinagar, Hyderabad describes itself as "An INI under the aegis of Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India". It is located in the Hyderabad Metropolitan Region (HMR), Telangana-508126. These Senior Resident posts are filled under the Government of India's Residency Scheme.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are 32 Senior Resident (Non-Academic) vacancies across 20 departments. Each department's category-wise vacancies are shown below. Notes on the vacancies: The vacancies are provisional and subject to variation. The Executive Director, AIIMS Bibinagar reserves the right to vary the vacancies, including reserved vacancies, as per Govt. of India rules, circulars and requirements. If suitable EWS candidates are not found, the EWS posts will not be carried forward or treated as backlog vacancies. UR candidates may also be allowed to apply provisionally against the EWS posts, and they may be considered if suitable EWS candidates are not found. Reservation will be as per Government of India Policy. If SC/ST/OBC and EWS candidates are not available for a post, that post will be filled for 89 days on contract basis from the available candidates, whatever their category.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from citizens of India. The cut-off date for the maximum age limit, essential qualification, experience and fee payment is 3 November 2026. To be eligible for selection, a candidate must have passed the qualifying examination by the cut-off date, with the result declared on or before that date. The prescribed qualification is only the minimum requirement. Holding it does not entitle a candidate to selection. The upper age limit is 45 years as on the last date of submission of application (3 November 2026). Age relaxation follows Government of India norms, up to the maximums below. SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply against unreserved vacancies will not get any age relaxation. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS applies as per Government of India policy. PwBD reservation is horizontal, within each candidate's own category. The disability certificate must be issued by a duly constituted and authorised Medical Board of a State or Central Government hospital or institution. It must be countersigned by the Medical Superintendent, CMO or Head of the hospital or institution. EWS/OBC/SC/ST candidates must have a caste certificate from the competent authority, valid for admission or jobs in Central Government institutions and issued before the date of interview. Without it, a candidate will not be allowed to appear in the interview in that category, but he or she can be treated as a UR candidate. The OBC certificate must be in the central format and issued within one year of the last date of application, that is, after 1 April 2026 and before the cut-off date. The candidate must belong to the non-creamy layer of the Central List of OBC. A candidate who does not produce a valid OBC certificate at the interview or document verification may be treated as UR. EWS status is for persons not covered by SC, ST or OBC reservation whose family's gross annual income is below ₹8 lakh. Income from all sources (salary, agriculture, business, profession, etc.) for the financial year before the year of application is counted. EWS candidates must have a valid income certificate in the prescribed format, or on the issuing authority's letterhead, before filling in the application. They must submit it at document verification, otherwise their candidature will be rejected. The certificate must have been issued on or after 1 April 2026 and before the cut-off date, and must be valid for the financial year 2026-27. For more on EWS, the notice refers to DoPT office order No.36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31 January 2019 (https://dopt.gov.in/sites/default/files/ewsf28fT.PDF). For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is for 89 days or up to the next regular interview, whichever is earlier. It gives no right to claim permanent absorption in the institute or a continued contractual appointment. The Institute may renew or end the appointment based on its evaluation of the candidate's performance. The post is a tenure engagement of a maximum of 89 days. Including any earlier engagement, it must not exceed the prescribed period for SR ship. Service as a Senior Resident in a previous appointment will be counted together with the present engagement at AIIMS Bibinagar. Leave will be as per the Central Residency Scheme and Institute policy. The appointee will not get benefits such as Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Seniority, Promotion or any other benefit available to regularly appointed Government servants. The appointment is full time, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Either side can end the appointment at any time by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary, without giving a reason. An appointee who leaves, resigns or is terminated before the tenure ends must give one month's notice as per the rules, or deposit pay and allowances for any shortfall in that notice period. The appointee must live in the residential accommodation provided by the Institute during the tenure as Senior Resident (Non Academic), subject to availability. Senior Residents must work in shifts and can be posted to any place or centre attached to the Institute, at the discretion of the MS/Dean/Executive Director. They may be assigned to one or more departments, depending on vacancies and institutional needs, and all must work in emergency on rotation as needed. The Competent Authority may assign any duty when required, and no extra allowance will be paid for such assignments.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the interview. Documents are verified before the interview on the same day. The list of selected candidates will be uploaded on https://aiimsbibinagar.edu.in. Venue for document verification: Examination Hall, II Floor, Academic Block, AIIMS, Bibinagar. Venue for the interview: Mini Board Room, 04th Floor, Academic Block, AIIMS, Bibinagar. The order of interviews may vary, and candidates should be available for the entire day. Candidates in service in any Government institution must bring a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer to the interview. Without it they will not be allowed to take part in the interview. Bring the following original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies: Duly filled Application Form (Annexure-I) Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhaar Card etc.) and Address Proof Certificate showing Date of Birth (Passport/Birth Certificate/Driving License) Class 10th & 12th Mark sheet and Certificates Qualifying degree: MBBS/M. Sc mark sheet and degree certificates; MD/DNB/MS/Ph. D degree certificate; DM/M.Ch/DNB degree certificates Internship Certificate Registration with Medical Council of India/State Medical Council Experience Certificate (if any) FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (for foreign graduates) Copy of fee receipt/payment proof Reservation category certificate (OBC/SC/ST/PwBD). OBC candidates must belong to the non-creamy layer of the Central List of OBC, and their certificate must have been issued within one year (older certificates will not be accepted). EWS certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026 and up to the last date of application, valid for financial year 2026-27 (EWS candidates) No Objection Certificate (NOC), if working in a Government institution Publications Candidates who do not produce these original documents at the interview will not be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 32 Senior Resident (Non-Academic) vacancies in 20 departments: UR 11, EWS 04, OBC 08, SC 06 and ST 03. General Medicine has the most, with 4 posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bibinagar Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online Google form is 3 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Late or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for AIIMS Bibinagar Senior Resident (Non-Academic)?
faq.answer: Each department asks for its own postgraduate medical degree, for example MD/DNB in General Medicine or MS/DNB in Orthopaedics. Some departments also accept a DM/M.Ch/DNB. For Anatomy and Biochemistry, non-medical candidates (Senior Demonstrators) need an M.Sc./M.Biotech in the subject concerned and a Ph.D in the subject concerned or an allied subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the last date of submission of application, 3 November 2026. The maximum relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10, 13 or 15 years for PwBD candidates in the General, OBC or SC/ST category.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at AIIMS Bibinagar?
faq.answer: Medical candidates get Pay Level 11 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, with an entry pay of Rs.67700/- plus NPA and other usual allowances. Non-medical candidates with M.Sc. and Ph.D. get Pay Level 10, with an entry pay of Rs. 56100/- plus other usual allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Bibinagar Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: UR/OBC/EWS candidates pay Rs.1770 (including 18% GST) plus transaction charges into the AIIMS Bibinagar account at Bank of Baroda. SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates pay no application fee, and the fee is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the online Google form, available on www.aiimsbibinagar.edu.in, by 3 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM. Then bring the filled Annexure-I form, the original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies to the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will AIIMS Bibinagar select Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an interview held on 16 and 17 November 2026 in the Mini Board Room, 04th Floor, Academic Block, AIIMS Bibinagar. Before the interview, documents are verified in the Examination Hall, II Floor, Academic Block, with reporting at 8.30 AM.
